title: COP31 summit targets major electrification push as 1.5C goal slips away
paragraphs: The COP31 climate summit, being jointly hosted by Türkiye and Australia, has conceded that the Earth will warm by more than 1.5 degrees.
Nations will push for greater electrification of energy and for less reliance on fossil fuels.
But both Australia and Türkiye are being criticised for their reliance on polluting energy sources.
